DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast milk jaundice.

The clinical picture of a well-appearing, term infant with weight gain, exclusively breastfed, and late-onset jaundice peaking around day 14-14 is classic for breast milk jaundice. I will not request further tests as the diagnosis is consistent with the history and physical exam findings provided.
